title: Ir a + Infinitive for Future Plans

sections.content: Use ir a + infinitive to talk about plans and intentions in the near future. Conjugate ir and keep the second verb in the infinitive: voy a escribir, vas a viajar, vamos a aprender. The infinitive does not change with the person.

items.english: I am going to write a letter.
We are going to travel tomorrow.
Carlos is going to learn Spanish.
They are going to keep the letters.

sections.content: In ir a + infinitive, only ir is conjugated: voy a escribir, vas a escribir, vamos a escribir. Do not conjugate the second verb.
